title: Dietetic Technicians
description: Assist in the provision of food service and nutritional programs, under the supervision of a dietitian. May plan and produce meals based on established guidelines, teach principles of food and nutrition, or counsel individuals.

tasks.text: Observe and monitor patient food intake and body weight, and report changes, progress, and dietary problems to dietician.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Clinical handoff carries accountability and nuance

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.
Monitor nutrition related activities of individuals or groups.
Inform medical professionals regarding patient conditions and care.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Conduct nutritional assessments of individuals, including obtaining and evaluating individuals' dietary histories, to plan nutritional programs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment goals need clinical accountability and context

dwas.name: Collect medical information from patients, family members, or other medical professionals.
Evaluate patient functioning, capabilities, or health.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

dwas.name: Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.

tasks.text: Prepare a major meal, following recipes and determining group food quantities.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Managing special meal prep is hands-on kitchen work

dwas.name: Manage preparation of special meals or diets.

tasks.text: Supervise food production or service or assist dietitians or nutritionists in food service supervision or planning.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical support supervision is live, accountable

dwas.name: Supervise medical support personnel.

tasks.text: Plan menus or diets or guide individuals or families in food selection, preparation, or menu planning, based upon nutritional needs and established guidelines.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Wellness advice needs tailoring and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Manage preparation of special meals or diets.
Provide health and wellness advice to patients, program participants, or caregivers.

tasks.text: Develop job specifications, job descriptions, or work schedules.

tasks.text: Attend interdisciplinary meetings with other health care professionals to discuss patient care.

tasks.text: Provide dietitians with assistance researching food, nutrition, or food service systems.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Select, schedule, or conduct orientation or in-service education programs.
